_: Inkling-2-Mini (thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini, 26B: 24 layers, layers 6..17 run three times) on maya-ik2 (src/ik2, docs/INKLING2.md section 8), an experimental preview: unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL GGUF at the repo's top - Unsloth's looped layout (general.architecture inkling2: inkling2.num_loops, inkling2.loop.core_start), which maya-ik2 reads; the files in Mainline_Support/ (inkling2_loop, llama.cpp master's) are not offered. Experts of layers 0-19 NVFP4 (their original bits), layers 20-23 and the dense weights Q8_0. The drafter: "drafter" below (the model's own, from Maya's repo; drafting auto by default). The file pinned by revision, size and sha256: the setup checks them.
name: Inkling-2-Mini-UD-Q4_K_XL
about: UD-Q4_K_XL: NVFP4 experts in layers 0-19, Q8_0 elsewhere; 26B parameters, 8 of 128 experts a token

vision._: The pictures: the model's vision tower (llama.cpp's inkling2v projector, BF16) from Maya's own repo - unsloth's conversion byte for byte (their mmproj-BF16.gguf, the same size and sha256; a copy of it already on the disk is used as it is), read by maya-vision (tools/vision/inkling2v_patch.py) when a picture arrives; not with --no-vision.

drafter._: Drafting: Inkling-2-Mini's own drafter (a DSpark-style draft model; Apache 2.0) from Maya's own repo at a pinned revision, in its two forms, the same drafter in each: unsloth's GGUF of it (llama.cpp's dflash architecture, Q8_0 matrices - their dspark-Inkling-2-Mini-Q8_0.gguf byte for byte), which maya-ik2 reads on its fastest drafting path ("default" and "amd": what the setup fetches, on NVIDIA and on AMD - measured on both), and thinkingmachines' mtp.safetensors (BF16, byte for byte), which earlier setups fetched. A whole copy of the GGUF already beside the model (the same size and sha256) is not downloaded again; an earlier setup's mtp.safetensors stays on the disk beside the GGUF the setup then fetches. Read by maya-ik2 --draft; not with --drafting off. With --drafting auto the engine measures once on the PC whether it (or the prompt lookup) makes answers faster, and drafting never changes the answers.
